```json
 "rationale": "A single high-impedance node gives a dominant pole at CL, so PM depends only on the folding and mirror poles, both well above GBW. Cascoded output gives about 52 dB. With gm1 of about 1.7 mS, GBW is about 200 MHz. Supply current: 2x240 uA in the PMOS sources, 40 uA bias, 10 uA reference, about 1 mW total. R-shifted diodes set Vds of about 0.3 V on the sources."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "itail":  (240e-6, 120e-6, 420e-6),
    "icas":   (120e-6, 60e-6, 250e-6),
    "gmid1":  (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),
    "L1":     (0.2, 0.15, 0.5),
    "gmid_t": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "Lt":     (0.4, 0.2, 1.0),
    "gmid_c": (11.0, 7.0, 16.0),
    "Lc":     (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),
    "Ln":     (0.5, 0.2, 1.5),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It = p["itail"]; Ic = p["icas"]; I1 = It / 2.0; Itop = I1 + Ic
    Ib1 = 20e-6; Ib2 = 20e-6
    Vt = 0.30   # target Vds of the PMOS current sources
    Vb = 0.30   # target Vds of the NMOS bottom mirror

    # Input pair: iterate the source voltage (body effect)
    vs = 0.2
    for _ in range(4):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=max(1.45 - vs, 0.3), vsb=vs)
        vs = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.05)
    vtail = vs

    # Bias mirrors from ibias
    mb0 = lut.size("n", 10, 0.5, iref, vds=0.65)
    m5 = lut.size("n", 10, 0.5, It, vds=max(vtail, 0.1))
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 10, 0.5, Ib1, vds=0.6)

    # PMOS folding current sources and their reference diodes
    mt = lut.size("p", p["gmid_t"], p["Lt"], Itop, vds=Vt)
    mpb = lut.size("p", p["gmid_t"], p["Lt"], Ib1, vds=mt.vgs)
    mpb2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_t"], p["Lt"], Ib2, vds=0.8)

    # Cascodes and bottom mirror
    pc = lut.size("p", p["gmid_c"], p["Lc"], Ic, vds=0.7, vsb=Vt)
    nc = lut.size("n", 12, 0.3, Ic, vds=0.45, vsb=Vb)
    mn = lut.size("n", 8, p["Ln"], Ic, vds=Vb)
    nd = lut.size("n", 8, p["Ln"], Ib2, vds=mn.vgs)

    # Level-shift resistors for the cascode gate biases
    vbp = vdd - mpb.vgs
    vcp = vdd - Vt - pc.vgs
    R1 = max((vbp - vcp) / Ib1, 500.0)
    R2 = max((Vb + nc.vgs - nd.vgs) / Ib2, 500.0)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("MB1", "vcp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MPB", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.R("R1", "vbp", "vcp", R1)
    n.dev("MPB2", "vcn", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mpb2)
    n.R("R2", "vcn", "nd", R2)
    n.dev("MND", "nd", "nd", "vss", "vss", nd)
    # input pair (vinp -> fa side = mirror-diode side, so vinp is non-inverting)
    n.dev("M1", "fa", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "fb", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # PMOS current sources
    n.dev("MT1", "fa", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mt)
    n.dev("MT2", "fb", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mt)
    # PMOS cascodes
    n.dev("MC1", "na", "vcp", "fa", "vdd", pc)
    n.dev("MC2", "vout", "vcp", "fb", "vdd", pc)
    # NMOS wide-swing cascode mirror
    n.dev("MNC1", "na", "vcn", "xa", "vss", nc)
    n.dev("MNC2", "vout", "vcn", "xb", "vss", nc)
    n.dev("MN1", "xa", "na", "vss", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("MN2", "xb", "na", "vss", "vss", mn)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    Rup = ((pc.gm + pc.gmbs) / pc.gds) / (mt.gds + m1.gds)
    Rdn = ((nc.gm + nc.gmbs) / nc.gds) / mn.gds
    Rout = Rup * Rdn / (Rup + Rdn)
    A0 = gm1 * Rout
    Cout = cl + pc.cdd + nc.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cout)
    Cfold = m1.cdd + mt.cdd + pc.cgg
    fp2 = (pc.gm + pc.gmbs) / (2 * PI * Cfold)
    Cmir = 2 * mn.cgg + nc.cdd + pc.cdd
    fpm = mn.gm / (2 * PI * Cmir)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fpm))
    power = vdd * (iref + 2 * Itop + Ib1 + Ib2)
    slew = min(It, 2 * Ic) / Cout
    swing = (vdd - Vt - pc.vdsat) - (Vb + nc.vdsat)

    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "swing": swing}
```
